phase: Discovery only; no defects established and no upstream task code executed
count_caveat: Task rows are not unique runtime images. Relationship between 989 General rows and 925 bundles remains to be reconciled; this is not a confirmed defect. Size API is live/cache-backed rather than revision-addressed.

packaging.note: This excludes bundled General documents and Docker images. Do not interpret HF displayed total size as the minimum audit download.

runtime_findings.code: Row instance_json supplies test_patch, test_command, image and cwd. Runtime resets patched paths, applies tests at reward time, rewards zero exit status.
runtime_findings.general: HF bundles contain instructions, manifests, tools, state, documents, verifier metadata and Python verifier code; some grading uses external LLM endpoints.
runtime_findings.cyber: ARVO vulnerability reproduction, binary crash validation; runtime source inspected by Sol, image contents not inspected.
runtime_findings.webdev: Screenshot/visual evaluation includes group-relative judging; requires external vision endpoint for full reward.
runtime_findings.music: ABC-to-MIDI validity and music feature scoring; source inspected by Sol, no scorer run.

sample_inspected.observation: Read-only business-analysis task over documents and four MCP-backed systems; verifier metadata includes weighted LLM rubric items. Documents and database contents have not been reviewed.
sample_inspected.audit_question: Reconcile requested behavior, accessible tools and evidence, active scoring criteria, and handling of unavailable judges. Do not claim violations based on source inspection alone.

version_caution: Dataset card update dated 2026-10-19 says Code images are preprocessed against reward hacking and anti_hack_cleanup must remain true. Current public release is not proven identical to historical training setup.
proposed_next_step: Build source-only row-to-artifact inventory; classify grader types and costs; select small tasks with explicit contracts and inexpensive checks before paid judging or rollouts.

delegation.primary: Verified counts, inspected Code reward path and one General bundle, synthesized and persisted evidence

usage_limitations: No paid external judge calls, Docker pulls, model rollouts or training runs. Exact delegated-agent dollar costs are unavailable.
